title: ASC 830 Foreign Currency Remeasurement - DemoCo Q2 2026
conclusionSummary: DemoCo's functional currency is the US dollar. At 2026-06-30 its EUR cash of 100,000 remeasures from 108,000.00 to 110,000.00 USD (a 2,000.00 gain) and its GBP trade payable of 50,000 from 63,000.00 to 64,000.00 USD (a 1,000.00 loss); the EUR prepayment is non-monetary and stays at 21,600.00 USD. The net transaction gain of 1,000.00 USD is in income.
